gates.name: validation fold coverage
gates.rationale: Require evidence from at least three chronological validation periods.

gates.name: positive validation folds
gates.rationale: Reject a candidate that loses money in any validation fold before holdout review.

gates.name: fixed-weight benchmark wins
gates.rationale: Require the candidate to beat the fixed-weight baseline in at least two of three validation folds.

gates.name: worst validation return
gates.rationale: Require nonnegative after-cost return in every validation fold.

gates.name: worst validation Sharpe
gates.rationale: Require a positive risk-adjusted result with margin above zero in every validation fold.

gates.name: validation drawdown cap
gates.rationale: Reject validation drawdown above twenty percent.

gates.name: gross exposure cap
gates.rationale: Keep average gross exposure within fully invested unlevered capital.

gates.name: session profit concentration cap
gates.rationale: Limit dependence on the five most profitable sessions in each validation fold.

gates.name: instrument profit concentration cap
gates.rationale: Require positive profit to come from more than one dominant instrument.

gates.name: doubled-cost retention
gates.rationale: Require at least eighty percent of base return after doubling modeled costs.

gates.name: two-bar-delay retention
gates.rationale: Require at least eighty percent of base return with a two-bar fill delay.

gates.name: parameter-neighbor retention
gates.rationale: Require nearby parameters to retain at least half of the base return.

gates.name: up-regime coverage
gates.rationale: Require enough positive SPY sessions in every validation fold for regime evidence.

gates.name: down-regime coverage
gates.rationale: Require enough negative SPY sessions in every validation fold for regime evidence.

gates.name: turnover cap
gates.rationale: Limit annual validation turnover before later execution-capacity analysis.

gates.name: trade count floor
gates.rationale: Require enough trades in every validation fold to avoid a result based on a few fills.

gates.name: search-volume cap
gates.rationale: Cap the recorded search near the planned campaign size and preserve every candidate as evidence.
